newsitem.title: USA: Safeway's Vons offer seen friendly -- arbs.
newsitem.headline: Safeway's Vons offer seen friendly -- arbs.

text.p: That Safeway Inc and Vons Cos Inc share a common history as well as common directors makes a friendly deal all the more likely in Safeway's bid for the roughly two-thirds of Von it does not own.
Arbitrageurs said Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co's majority ownership of Safeway -- about 52 percent -- further supports their view that the companies will combine in a negotiated deal.

KKR is the linch pin in the shared board seats: Robert MacDonnell is a KKR general partner and director of both Safeway and Vons, and James Greene is a KKR executive and also director of both, according to an arb.
Also, Safeway chairman Peter Magowan and president Steve Burd are each on both boards.

Members of the nine-seat Safeway board who are not on the 12-member Vons board include Paul Hazen, chairman of Wells Fargo and Co and Henry Kravis of the New York buyout firm Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.

"My guess is it's friendly. There are a lot of overlapping board members and there's (Safeway's) ownership of (Vons) stock," said a second arbitrageur "From a fairness standpoint, Safeway had to make it look favorable for Vons," he said.
Early Wednesday, Safeway offered to acquire the majority of Vons it does not own in a stock swap valuing Vons at $58 per share.
Vons has not yet responded to the offer.
In early afternoon trade, Vons shares were up 10-1/4 to 53-3/8 while Safeway fell 1-7/8 to 41-1/2.
